name: branchleft-mail
comment: @pulumi/hcloud is pinned exactly, not caret-ranged, for the same reason branchleft-shared-infra pins @pulumi/gcp: the default provider's version is part of every resource's URN, and this stack's first `pulumi import` needs the provider version stable across that operation and every preview afterwards. Bump deliberately, after an import has landed, and read the preview.
